rules.title: Housing discrimination and prohibited applicant inquiries (publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located housing)
rules.requirement: Owners, brokers, managing agents and their agents may not refuse to rent to, or discriminate against, a person because of race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran or military status, or handicap. They also may not make any written or oral inquiry or record about these characteristics of a rental applicant.
rules.coverage_conditions: Publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, or contiguously located housing accommodations; applies to owners, lessees, sublessees, licensed brokers, assignees, managing agents, their agents and employees, and condo/co-op unit-owner organizations.
rules.exemptions: The age protection does not apply to minors. It also does not apply to residency in qualifying elderly housing: state- or federally-aided elderly developments, LIHTC 55+/62+ developments, and registered 55+/62+ communities.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies to 'publicly assisted', 'multiple dwelling' or 'contiguously located' housing as defined in c.151B §1 (definitions not in this document)

rules.quoted_span: (c) to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry or marital status of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation
rules.conflict_note: Effective date is not stated in the document; the statute is long-standing and was amended over time.

rules.title: Housing discrimination and prohibited inquiries (other covered housing accommodations)
rules.requirement: Owners and agents of other covered housing may not refuse to rent to, or discriminate against, a person on protected bases, including veteran status, blindness, hearing impairment, guide dog use or other handicap. They also may not make inquiries or keep records about these characteristics of rental applicants.
rules.coverage_conditions: Other covered housing accommodations and land intended for housing under c.151B §1 subsections 10-13; applies to owners, lessees, sublessees, brokers, managing agents and their agents.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to leasing a single apartment in a two-family dwelling where the owner occupies the other unit. Age-based exemptions also apply for minors and qualifying elderly housing.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: 'Other covered housing accommodations' defined in c.151B §1 (not in this document). Owner-occupied two-family exemption.

rules.quoted_span: provided, however, that this subsection shall not apply to the leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied by the owner as his residence.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date is not stated in the document.

rules.title: Ban on discrimination against public assistance and housing subsidy recipients
rules.requirement: Anyone providing rental accommodations may not discriminate against a person because the person receives public assistance or a housing subsidy, such as rental assistance or vouchers. Landlords also may not discriminate because of the requirements of such a program.
rules.quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements, because the individual is such a recipient, or because of any requirement of such public assistance, rental assistance, or housing subsidy program.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date is not stated in the document.

rules.title: Ban on refusing to rent to households with children
rules.requirement: Owners and agents of covered housing may not refuse to rent to, or discriminate against, a person because a child or children will live in the unit. Local, state and federal occupancy limits still apply.
rules.coverage_conditions: Publicly assisted, multiple dwelling, contiguously located, or other covered housing accommodations; applies to owners, brokers, managing agents and their agents.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to: (1) dwellings of three or fewer apartments where one is occupied by an elderly (65+) or infirm person for whom children would be a hardship; (2) temporary leasing, up to one year, of an owner's principal residence during the owner's absence; (3) leasing one unit of an owner-occupied two-family dwelling.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exemptions depend on owner occupancy, an elderly or infirm occupant in a building of 3 or fewer units, and temporary leasing during the owner's absence.

rules.quoted_span: to refuse to rent or lease or sell or otherwise to deny to or withhold from any person such accommodations because such person has a child or children who shall occupy the premises with such person
rules.conflict_note: Effective date is not stated in the document.
